# adw-gtk3, dark variant

The dark variant (`adw-gtk3-dark`) of [adw-gtk3](https://github.com/lassekongo83/adw-gtk3)
v6.5, the libadwaita look for GTK 3 apps and for GTK 4 apps without libadwaita. These
files are unmodified, from the release asset `adw-gtk3v6.5.tar.xz` (SHA-256
`a81780fadfc432be0fc3d89c4ebb41aa28e4f032d42c36f9789c57dd10cfa41c`):

- `gtk-3.0/gtk.css`, the same file as the release's `gtk-dark.css`, and its `assets/`;
- `gtk-4.0/libadwaita.css`, `gtk-4.0/libadwaita-tweaks.css` and their `assets/`.

`build-gtk.py` turns them into the CachyOS Teal GTK theme. adw-gtk3 is distributed under
the GNU LGPL v2.1 (`LICENSE`); its sources are in the repository above.
